mu_name_from: The Dungeon's object slot 1, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123).
sheet_from: Data/Object2/, from MuMain, decoded under a dn_ prefix.
why_this_one: A cobweb strung in a corner, 58 of them: the dimmed additive copy of its sheet (dn_cobweb_glow.png), since cut out it read too solid and too bright. Seen in the world 2026-09-30 at 130,241, faint over the iron grate, as asked.
additive_from: A departure, marked. MU draws cobweb.tga and steel_02.tga alpha-blended; this engine has an opaque cutout or an added glow and nothing between, and as cutouts the threads stood full bright and solid (the user, 2026-09-30: 'spider webs look very light, they need to be more transparent'). So each is its own sheet premultiplied by its alpha and dimmed (cobweb 0.4, steel_02 0.55) into dn_*_glow.png, and added: black adds nothing, and a thread over the dark reads as a faint silver line with the room behind it.
